baseRef: local main and origin/main at inspection; no fetch performed
publication: Patch prepared for iOS repository evidence only; no backend commit, push, deploy or production access.

patch.applyCheck: PASS: applied to pristine base file in a fresh temporary directory; both resulting files matched isolated worktree bytes.

diagnosis: SaveDevice did not lock/revalidate users while DeleteAccount locked users then removed devices and physically deleted or anonymized the account. A late save recreated tombstone device credentials or failed with FK/HTTP500 after physical deletion.
behavior: SaveDevice locks users FOR UPDATE in its transaction before device quota/advisory lock and upsert. Missing/empty-password actors return ErrUnauthorized/401; blocked actors return ErrAccountBlocked/403; guests return ErrForbidden/403. Successful save-first registration is removed by subsequent deletion; delete-first registration is rejected.

lockOrderReview.SaveDevice: users FOR UPDATE -> per-user :devices advisory lock -> device count/upsert
lockOrderReview.DeleteAccount: users FOR UPDATE -> personal cleanup including push_devices -> physical users delete or tombstone
lockOrderReview.RevokeDevice: push_devices update only; no users or advisory lock acquisition
lockOrderReview.scope: No outbox, in-flight provider delivery or unrelated writer changes.

determinism: Each order uses two actual repository transactions nested in explicit outer transactions. Independent connection observes exact pg_blocking_pids dependency before first commit. Deadline/ticker only bound polling; elapsed delay never establishes order.

postgres.version: PostgreSQL 17.10 on aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

environment.storage: new tmpfs PostgreSQL data; no named volume
environment.database: audit_backend; schema-per-case real migrations via existing auditDatabase guard
environment.cleanup: PASS: no remaining audit schemas/user relations before removal; only owned container removed; private temporary DSN file deleted.

testEnvironment: MEETSPACE_AUDIT_POSTGRES_DSN must point to a new disposable loopback PostgreSQL database named audit_backend; no application .env loaded.
limitations: Local PostgreSQL17 integration coverage, not backend deployment or a production-backend retest.
No backend schema migration needed; queued/in-flight push delivery is outside this change.
No guarantee for transactions intentionally using non-default isolation levels; tested actual repository READ COMMITTED behavior.
